description: Named by the fz-go4.19 correctness audit (at 723126abe). product_drive_test.rs pins the four ProductDriveError hook message templates by calling the impls directly, but no test forces drive_root_backend_product itself into no_ready_producer / fact_wait_budget_exceeded / did_not_settle / job_failed through a real drive — the wiring (correct root/fact/job arguments passed from a genuine failure) is untested end-to-end. The test file's own doc comment discloses this. TASK: one production-path test per failure shape (e.g. artificially exhaust PRODUCT_DRIVE_BUDGET with a tiny budget override or an unresolvable fact; drive a real World to each failure), asserting the surfaced error/diagnostic matches the pinned template. Tests use production paths — no fabricated JobEffects states. Test-only, two-lane audit.
title: Production-path coverage for ProductDriveError failure hooks
